name: Shiny Bush

start.dialog: [Excited rustling] Shiny! So shiny here! Want to be shiny too! Collect small crystals! Stick to branches! Make me PRETTIEST bush! Please?
start.objective: Collect 20 small Prism crystals to decorate the Bush

progress.dialog: [Waving hopefully] More shiny? More pretty? Make me sparkle!
progress.objective: Continue gathering small crystals for the Bush

complete.dialog: [Shimmering with joy] SO SPARKLY! Prettiest bush EVER! Here - found this near roots! Shiny thing! For you!

party_comments.kade: We're decorating a bush. This is my life now.
party_comments.twist: It's so sparkly! Like a Christmas tree!
party_comments.renna: Crystal adhesion to organic matter. Interesting.

hidden_outcome: If you bring 50 crystals, the Bush evolves into 'Crystal Guardian' and follows you as a cosmetic pet
